name: spn-apps
description: SaaS Plane apps domain, stack-agnostic — what an application is made of before any language is chosen: the contract model a module publishes, the rules a contract state follows, and the platform worksheet a partner fills in to decide which of the shipped modules they adopt. Its skills open it: new, implement, review, run, verify, release and design. A ref reaches a session only when something names it.
